messages:
clare: Pushed a small prototype for Prompt Sets > Eval Runs focusing on keyboard-first approval flows. Trying an approach where approve is in toolbar but also available via Enter when a row is focused. figma: https://figma.com/file/keyboard-first
amos: Nice. Keyboard-first is great for power reviewers. Couple questions: how do we prevent accidental approves when users navigate quickly with Enter?
devon: Maybe require a focused row + focused approve command. Eg: Enter opens diff; Shift+Enter approves. Or use Enter to open, A to approve when the list is focused.
clare: I prototyped: Enter toggles preview, press "a" while a row is focused to toggle selection, and Alt+Enter approves selected. There's also a persistent toolbar "Approve selected" for mouse users.
priya: Accessibility: make sure shortcuts are scoped to the list container. If focus is in a textarea inside a diff, the "a" key shouldn't trigger selection. Also add a tooltip showing the shortcut on hover for toolbar button.
a11y-bot: a11y note: Announce keyboard actions on first load with a collapsible help line: "Tip: press 'A' to select runs, Alt+Enter to approve when focus is on the list". Use aria-expanded for the help line and store user preference (dismissed) in localStorage. Also ensure announceable feedback: use aria-live polite for "3 runs selected" and after approval "Approved 3 runs. Undo available".
amos: Microcopy: toolbar label should be 'Approve selected' and confirmation modal should say: 'Approve 3 runs? This will lock the scorecards and mark them as reviewed. Only project admins can unapprove. [Learn more]'. Avoid vague 'Are you sure?'.
devon: UX safety: add a soft threshold block. If any selected run has a quality score below the project threshold (configurable), show a warning in the modal: '2 selected runs have quality < 60. Approving will bypass alerts.' Provide explicit checkbox 'I acknowledge approving low-quality runs'.
priya: Good idea. Also include per-run inline badges for quality so reviewers can scan before selecting. For screen readers add hidden text 'Quality score: 54. Below project threshold.'
clare: I'll add the threshold warning and the acknowledge checkbox to the modal. Also changing toast copy to: 'Approved 5 runs. [Undo] [Open change log]'. Undo keeps prior state for 12s.
a11y-bot: Important: when undo is used, announce 'Undo performed. 5 runs unapproved' and return focus to the toolbar approve button. Also in the change-log view, ensure it's keyboard-trap free and ESC closes it.
devon: One more: onboarding hint for new users. Show a one-time in-product coach that highlights the approve toolbar, keyboard shortcuts, and explains the threshold rule. Dismiss state persists per user.
amos: Visual nits: increase checkboxes to 24px, add high-contrast focus ring for keyboard navigation, and ensure chevrons are at least 40px target.
priya: I'll run a keyboard-only and NVDA/VoiceOver pass once the prototype is updated and paste a short checklist for dev (tab order, aria labels, aria-live examples).
clare: Great. I'll update the prototype with: scoped shortcuts, threshold-aware modal with acknowledgement, improved copy, toast undo 12s, onboarding coach, and a11y adjustments. Will post new link by EOD. :thumbsup:
